title: Finite continuous linear representations
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and $G$ a topological group. The category of finite continuous left $R$-modules with $G$-action is the full subcategory of discrete continuous representations [def-exc-discrete-modules-category] whose underlying sets are finite. Its morphisms are equivariant $R$-linear maps. Continuity is for the discrete topology, equivalently every element has an open stabilizer. The forgetful functor retains the underlying $G$-set. For comparison the category of finite discrete continuous $G$-sets is Mathlib ContAction(FintypeCat,G), with equivariant maps; it has finite products given by diagonal actions and the terminal singleton.
